title: alsine viscosa var. hybrida
intro: Alsine viscosa var. hybrida, commonly known as sticky wintergreen, is a plant species in the saxifrage family. It is used for its medicinal properties, which include the potential health benefits of reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Alsine viscosa var. hybrida include its ability to relieve pain, soothe digestive issues, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
